accelerated_attention_density.note: Applies 10% density to every attention pair, even though FastH3 keeps text/audio paths dense; intentionally favorable to H3.

base_denoise_calls.note: Fifty sigma grid points execute N-1 transformer forwards.
base_denoise_calls.source: pinned Diffusers denoise schedule and FastVideo code

sequence_parallel_degree.note: Matches the published eight-GPU Ulysses benchmark topology.

text_tokens.note: Video rows dominate; prompt-dependent packed text length is not fixed by the release.

baseline_critical_cut_fraction.note: Fraction of attention tensor injection serialized across the modeled global bisection.
baseline_critical_cut_fraction.source: explicit sensitivity input; no Oasis/OpenTallas floorplan exists

cache_remote_fraction_sweep.note: Zero means spatially sharded temporal KV remains local; one means every cache byte crosses the global bisection.

cache_fill_passes.note: The completed frame needs one pass at the fixed context timestep before its temporal K/V can be installed.

runtime_weight_bytes_per_parameter.note: Checkpoint headers were inaccessible; the code-derived model is evaluated as BF16-equivalent.

rom_row_reuse.interpretation: whole_call is the current batched ROM-as-storage semantics; integer R re-serves a matrix after R activation rows and is a service-byte proxy, not validated compute-in-ROM timing

fast_h3_b200.workload: FastH3 Preview v1, four DiT calls, 90% sparse video-video attention, 1344x768 at 24 fps, median of three after warmup

h3_b300.workload: FL2VA, 1344x768, 124 frames, 24 fps, 50 scheduler grid points, one warm request

oasis_demo.workload: proprietary interactive demo; hardware/model-size/runtime details are insufficient for numerical calibration of the public 500M code

comparison_contract.gpu: Existing B300 profiles price immutable and mutable bytes in shared HBM and use aggregate configured BF16 compute.
comparison_contract.overlap: Within a phase compute overlaps storage; ROM immutable and mutable services overlap; critical-cut NoC serialization is then added. Phases serialize.
comparison_contract.rom: One model fits one ROM wafer stage. The profile device_count is a maximum pipeline depth and does not multiply one-stage wafer compute.
comparison_contract.same_compute_hbm: Counterfactual keeps the selected ROM wafer's compute, efficiency, pipeline, and NoC identical, but moves immutable weights to that wafer's HBM. This isolates storage placement from the wafer compute envelope.

questions: Does full-window Oasis benefit from immutable ROM service, or is it prefill-like?
Can an exact causal temporal-KV transformation lower row reuse enough for ROM to matter?
When do compute, mutable KV, or communication erase that benefit?
Why is a full-clip bidirectional video DiT such as MiniMax-H3 less favorable?
